**Failure and retry history.** Acceptance-first and TDD failures are recorded in the [implementation journal](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/docs/implementation/admin-s2-5-01a.md). Independent review exposed the SDK's missing/null-to-false default; real-wire acceptance was red (4 pass, 2 fail), then green (6 pass). The compiled focused/affected run passes 246 cases. The earlier 4,815 + 49 full run is superseded by the corrected 4,827 + 49 run. Missing dependencies and the direct-TypeScript parameter-property error were setup failures, not behavior reds. Compiled tests passed. An initial concurrent metrics snapshot rejected changed inputs; sequential retry and final snapshot pass. Full [run history](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/386056b73a9b8a01614a7299371b1c750b700db5/review-evidence/s2-5-01a/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/README.md#candidate-and-run-history) retains these results and prior PR text.

**Coverage provenance.** Verified complete unit backend/portal coverage was captured at `313f980a3ac76ec9c95d5dbc346fb9bb7699e442`. All source, test, dependency, and build inputs match final HEAD; later commits only add metric history and implementation documentation. Final processing validates source/input fingerprints. The final snapshots, process, CRAP, impact, and checker name this candidate and base. See [coverage](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/386056b73a9b8a01614a7299371b1c750b700db5/review-evidence/s2-5-01a/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/reports/coverage.json), [base](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/386056b73a9b8a01614a7299371b1c750b700db5/review-evidence/s2-5-01a/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/reports/snapshot-base.json), and [head](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/386056b73a9b8a01614a7299371b1c750b700db5/review-evidence/s2-5-01a/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/reports/snapshot.json). Base CRAP derived from head coverage is an estimate.

**Limits and N/A.** Node 24.20.0 and verified pinned Lightpanda 1.0.0 were used. The hosted image was built at code-identical `543550dff9d1d88aaa69e2285678e18b74b36aed`. The live gate covers the changed reader through existing journeys; new deletion against live WorkOS remains S2.5-02. No release or deployment was performed. Search-live, logging PostgreSQL, and Audit Collector gates are N/A because their source behavior is unchanged. The declaration emitter's 33 diagnostics are in two unchanged, unlisted modules; full type checking and public snapshots pass ([details](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/386056b73a9b8a01614a7299371b1c750b700db5/review-evidence/s2-5-01a/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/checks/declaration-diagnostics.log)). GitHub returned no workflow runs or status checks for this head at publication; the evidence above is local.

## Quality review

Candidate: [122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58)  
Trusted main merge base: [9d0546b93d37e74ee9ddc7d9f7f4a66b18de0546](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/9d0546b93d37e74ee9ddc7d9f7f4a66b18de0546). This is not a stack.

**T2 Need architect — T2: declarations changed in 1 public module.** Reasons: fact d changes the directory declaration; `impact.internalInterface` also requires T2; `impact.sensitiveBehavior` requires T1. The [committed impact declaration](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/.pr-impact.json) and [base/head-bound report](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/386056b73a9b8a01614a7299371b1c750b700db5/review-evidence/s2-5-01a/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/checks/tier-final.json) cover the complete candidate. No fact is undeclared. The preliminary checker reports eligible with no local blockers. Overall merge status is **blocked pending independent authorized human architect approval of this head**. No human approval or de-escalation is recorded.

**Policy answer.** The changed input/output promise belongs to the internal directory. It exposes ordinary/external/unknown management evidence and exact-ID membership deletion. Normal void completion is applied; only the documented 422 refusal proves unsupported/no effect. Other errors throw unchanged with unknown effects. There is no browser/MCP removal API or current application caller. S2.5-01b owns admission, current authority, serialization, and last-Admin safety. All grant slugs remain available, including permissionless grants.

**Metrics and retained findings.** The [full process](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/386056b73a9b8a01614a7299371b1c750b700db5/review-evidence/s2-5-01a/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/reports/process.md), [review](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/386056b73a9b8a01614a7299371b1c750b700db5/review-evidence/s2-5-01a/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/reports/review.json), [function report](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/386056b73a9b8a01614a7299371b1c750b700db5/review-evidence/s2-5-01a/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/reports/crap.json), and [detailed dispositions](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/386056b73a9b8a01614a7299371b1c750b700db5/review-evidence/s2-5-01a/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/README.md#coverage-and-metrics-disposition) are retained. All 17 added/changed functions meet CRAP goals: highest added 4, highest changed 7. One unmeasured function is unchanged. No added/changed function has an unknown required assessment. No metric exception is used.

- WorkOS provider MI: **53.4834 → 48.1109**. Retain the existing cohesive adapter and its short mapping, reader, and deletion functions (1–4 paths). Splitting existing invitation/member operations solely for the file score would expand the ticket and add interfaces. This reason covers both the 5.37 drop note and the high review finding.
- Hosted composition MI: **56.2086 → 56.1691**. Retain provider/resource lifecycle ownership; this change adds one reader binding. A lifecycle refactor would add unrelated risk.
- Connection integration test MI: **49.0302 → 39.1443**, a high review finding. Keep the independent transport-outcome/timeout cases with the existing real-client fixture and isolated state. A metric-driven test framework would obscure the contract. Tests have no MI goal.
- No new production file is below MI 85. The contract-only directory has no meaningful function MI. The process's exit 1 is an assessed goal miss, not a tool failure; trusted policy permits the documented existing-file dispositions.

**Habit-hooks.** The [complete log](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/386056b73a9b8a01614a7299371b1c750b700db5/review-evidence/s2-5-01a/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/checks/habit-hooks-final.log) lists every location. Retain: (1) unchanged `composeWorkOSApplication` complexity because it owns ordered cleanup; (224) comments that preserve authority, provider constraints, unknown effects, the SDK workaround, filters, and fixture isolation; (10) oversized provider/fake/member-test files that keep cohesive public-boundary cases with independent state. Mechanical splits would expand this ticket. No correctness or boundary lint finding is suppressed. Snooze remains `[]`.

**Checker informational notes.** Of 48 public modules, one snapshot changes. The three transitively touched modules—`administration-overviews`, `customer-roles`, and `organization-administration`—retain their declarations, grant checks, view filtering, and authority. The provider MI drop and high-finding notes have the retained reasons above.

<details><summary>Architecture assessment and pinned provenance</summary>

All 13 registry Mermaid blocks are unchanged byte-for-byte ([inventory](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/386056b73a9b8a01614a7299371b1c750b700db5/review-evidence/s2-5-01a/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/checks/architecture-inventory.json)). No component, dependency edge, public module, L2 container, or deployment changes.

The [full evidence record](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/386056b73a9b8a01614a7299371b1c750b700db5/review-evidence/s2-5-01a/122d65bf1f035fc195792cc083732aa05c423c58/README.md#architecture-assessment-and-approval) links both source revisions and records caller/test impact.

The main summary holds the authoritative fact-d comparison: folded declaration diff and four behavior notes. No component drawing is required. The strongest changed callable contract is `deleteMembership`; the review question is exact-target effects and treatment of uncertain failure. The contract and behavior notes answer it, so L4 would add no information. No drawing changes or is added; rendering and normal-width inspection are N/A. No ADR was requested for this bounded extension.

Independent agent review found the SDK normalization issue; the real-wire red tests drove the correction. Independent re-review found no remaining code/test issue. The manager reviewed the complete source, tests, contract, registry assessment, and final evidence and signs off the implementation. This is not human approval. Scoped live deletion proof remains S2.5-02.

</details>
